$comment: Hand-maintained structural half of the chart schema. gen.py merges in env/envSecret validation from contract.yaml and writes chart/edspace/values.schema.json.

adapter.description: Delivery backend. 'none' disables transactional email; sign-in then relies on passwords and/or SSO and invitation links are handed over manually.

smtp.description: Settings for adapter smtp. Leave tls/auth empty to keep the application's own defaults, which depend on ssl and username.

existingSecret.description: Customer-managed Secret holding the mailer credential - the MailPace API key, or the SMTP password when adapter is smtp.

existingSecretKey.description: Key inside existingSecret. Defaults to mailpace-api-key for adapter mailpace and smtp-password for adapter smtp.

then.$comment: An HPA with no metrics is invalid; require at least one target.

env.description: Extra non-secret environment variables from the app contract (rendered into the app ConfigMap). Unknown names are rejected - use extraEnv/extraEnvFrom for variables outside the contract.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.description: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET is a secret - set it under envSecret (or the matching structured value) instead.

MICROSOFT_BASE_URL.description: Microsoft identity platform base URL. Unset, the app derives "https://login.microsoftonline.com/<MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID>/v2.0" from MICROSOFT_TENANT_ID; set this only for a cloud whose endpoint differs (US Gov, China 21Vianet) or an internal proxy.

PRAXIS_CLIENT_ID.description: Praxis/Egmont OIDC client id (PKCE public client).

PRAXIS_LICENSE_API_KEY.description: PRAXIS_LICENSE_API_KEY is a secret - set it under envSecret (or the matching structured value) instead.

PRAXIS_PRODUCT_URL.description: Praxis product URL used in license redirects.

DEBUG_AUTH_FAILURES.description: Set to "true" to log detailed SSO failure reasons. WARNING - logs may then contain personal data; enable only while troubleshooting.

EDSPACE_PLATFORM_ADMINS.description: Comma-separated emails granted platform-admin on reconciliation. This is the first-admin bootstrap: a fresh install has no account that can reach the backoffice, so set this and then run `bin/edspace rpc 'Edspace.Accounts.AdminReconcilerWorker.enqueue()'` inside the app container. Additive only — it never demotes an existing admin. Read at job-perform time on the serving node.

MEMBER_PURGE_ENABLED.description: Kill switch for the nightly member-purge sweep. Set "false" to stop it without a deploy — the worker then discards. Any other value (including unset) leaves the sweep ON.

MEMBER_PURGE_GLOBAL_CAP.description: Most users one run may purge fleet-wide. A larger due-set refuses the whole run, because a mass expiry usually means a sync fault or a config error that an operator should look at before anything is deleted.

MEMBER_PURGE_STALE_SYNC_HOURS.description: Roster-freshness window. The run refuses unless some completed roster sync finished inside it, and a school's members are held back unless that school appeared in one — deleting on a night the sync did not deliver would deny exactly the people it protects their comeback.

MEMBER_PURGE_RETENTION_NOTICE_DAYS.description: Floor on every deadline, measured from when a school's retention was last changed, so lowering a retention window gives a visible notice period instead of a same-night mass deletion.

MEMBER_PURGE_ABANDON_AFTER_MINUTES.description: How stale an in-progress purge run must be before the next run may reclaim its single-active slot.

PDF_ENABLED.description: Enables the headless-Chromium PDF export subsystem. The packaging layer forces "false" in migration/seed jobs.

CHROMIC_PDF_POOL_SIZE.description: Concurrent Chromium sessions for PDF rendering. Each session costs memory; lower it on small instances.

CHROMIC_PDF_CHROME_EXECUTABLE.description: Path override for the Chromium binary.

LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Langfuse public key. LLM tracing activates only when LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY, LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY and LANGFUSE_HOST are all set; leave empty to disable tracing.

LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY.description: LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY is a secret - set it under envSecret (or the matching structured value) instead.

LANGFUSE_HOST.description: Langfuse host receiving OpenTelemetry traces (your own Langfuse instance).

LANGFUSE_BASE_URL.description: Langfuse REST API base URL — the read/query side (prompt fetches, usage and fair-use lookups), separate from the OTLP span exporter. Falls back to LANGFUSE_HOST, so one host variable can drive both the push and pull paths, and then to Langfuse's public cloud: an install that sets LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY without either host variable sends its queries to cloud.langfuse.com. Point this at your own instance, or leave all three unset.

LANGFUSE_TIMEOUT.description: Langfuse REST client timeout in SECONDS — integer or float, not milliseconds. The effective default is 5 seconds; a value like 5000 would mean 5000 seconds, and a non-numeric value raises.

EDSPACE_OTEL_LLM_PAYLOADS.description: Whether prompt/completion text is included in telemetry spans. Set to "none" to strip payloads (recommended when traces leave your infrastructure).

OTEL_BSP_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE.description: OpenTelemetry batch span processor queue size.

OTEL_BSP_SCHEDULE_DELAY_MS.description: OpenTelemetry batch span processor flush interval.

OTEL_BSP_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: OpenTelemetry batch span processor export timeout.

SOCKET_DRAINER_BATCH_SIZE.description: WebSockets disconnected per batch during graceful shutdown.

SOCKET_DRAINER_SHUTDOWN_MS.description: Total socket-drain budget on shutdown. The chart's terminationGracePeriodSeconds must exceed this (default 45s vs 30s).

ULIMIT_NOFILE.description: Soft file-descriptor limit the release requests at boot. The orchestrator must grant a hard limit at least this high (compose sets ulimits; modern Kubernetes runtimes default higher).

ERL_FLAGS.description: Extra BEAM VM flags appended at boot.

LANGFUSE_TIMEOUT.description: Langfuse REST client timeout in SECONDS — integer or float, not milliseconds. The effective default is 5 seconds; a value like 5000 would mean 5000 seconds, and a non-numeric value raises.

EDSPACE_OTEL_LLM_PAYLOADS.description: Whether prompt/completion text is included in telemetry spans. Set to "none" to strip payloads (recommended when traces leave your infrastructure).

OTEL_BSP_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE.description: OpenTelemetry batch span processor queue size.

OTEL_BSP_SCHEDULE_DELAY_MS.description: OpenTelemetry batch span processor flush interval.

OTEL_BSP_EXPORT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: OpenTelemetry batch span processor export timeout.

SOCKET_DRAINER_BATCH_SIZE.description: WebSockets disconnected per batch during graceful shutdown.

SOCKET_DRAINER_SHUTDOWN_MS.description: Total socket-drain budget on shutdown. The chart's terminationGracePeriodSeconds must exceed this (default 45s vs 30s).

ULIMIT_NOFILE.description: Soft file-descriptor limit the release requests at boot. The orchestrator must grant a hard limit at least this high (compose sets ulimits; modern Kubernetes runtimes default higher).

ERL_FLAGS.description: Extra BEAM VM flags appended at boot.

RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION.description: RELEASE_DISTRIBUTION is composed by the deployment packaging - never set it directly.

RELEASE_NODE.description: RELEASE_NODE is composed by the deployment packaging - never set it directly.

RELEASE_COOKIE.description: RELEASE_COOKIE is composed by the deployment packaging - never set it directly.

DISCARD_ASSISTANT_DRAFTS.description: One-shot flag consumed by the 2026-05 assistant-lifecycle migration.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: POSTGRES_PASSWORD is a compose-only deployment setting, not read by the app.

EDSPACE_IMAGE.description: EDSPACE_IMAGE is a compose-only deployment setting, not read by the app.

EDSPACE_IMAGE_TAG.description: EDSPACE_IMAGE_TAG is a compose-only deployment setting, not read by the app.

EDSPACE_PORT.description: EDSPACE_PORT is a compose-only deployment setting, not read by the app.

allOf.$comment: External DB mode a needs host+password; mode b needs an existing Secret URL key; mode c needs host+existing Secret.
Explicit secrets are mandatory when auto-generation is off.
Multiple replicas, including HPA scale-out, require clustering and either Blob storage or persistent ReadWriteMany local storage.
A ReadWriteOnce local uploads PVC cannot safely attach to a surge pod during rolling updates.
Azure Blob must have an account/container and a key source.
An LLM credential is required, with external env mechanisms as explicit escape hatches.
adapter mailpace needs an API key, from a value or a customer-managed Secret.
adapter smtp needs a relay host; the app raises at boot without one.
Any real provider needs a verified sender address; adapter none does not.
Azure LLM deployments need an endpoint and all three deployment names.
